title: Healing Words
description: Curated journeys through the teachings of Rabbi Nachman and his students, organized by theme to guide and uplift the soul.

journeys.title: Finding Joy
journeys.description: Joy is the foundation of serving Hashem. This journey walks through the deepest teachings on simcha — from the great mitzvah to always be joyful, through the power of song and dance, to finding good points even in the darkest times.

steps.title: A Great Mitzvah to Always Be Joyful
steps.description: The foundational teaching: joy heals, sadness destroys. All illness comes from the spoiling of joy.
steps.snippet_he: מצוה גדולה להיות בשמחה תמיד, ולהתגבר להרחיק העצבות והמרה שחרה בכל כחו
steps.snippet_en: It is a great mitzvah to always be in joy and to strengthen oneself with all one's might to remove sadness and melancholy.

steps.title: A Broken Heart vs. Sadness
steps.description: Rabbi Nachman distinguishes between a broken heart (precious to Hashem) and sadness (from the Other Side).
steps.snippet_he: לב נשבר ועצבות אינו ענין אחד כלל. כי לב נשבר הוא בלב, אבל עצבות הוא בא מן הטחול
steps.snippet_en: A broken heart and sadness are not the same thing at all. A broken heart is in the heart, but sadness comes from the spleen.

steps.title: In the Matter of Joy
steps.description: Even when you cannot feel genuine joy, force yourself through silly things — the joy itself will become real.
steps.snippet_he: בענין השמחה
steps.snippet_en: In the matter of joy — one should force oneself to be happy, even through foolish things.

steps.title: Azamra — Finding Good Points
steps.description: The famous teaching: judge yourself favorably by finding even a small good point, and through this you are moved from the scale of guilt to merit.
steps.snippet_he: דע, שצריך לדון את כל אדם לכף זכות
steps.snippet_en: Know, that one must judge every person favorably — even one who is completely wicked, one must search and find some small good.

steps.title: Joy of Mitzvos — The Middle of the World
steps.description: Through performing mitzvos with joy, one elevates the Divine Presence and draws blessings to all worlds.
steps.snippet_he: ודע שאי אפשר להשיג אותו אפלו בבחינת מטי ולא מטי. אלא על ידי עשית המצוות בשמחה
steps.snippet_en: Know that it is impossible to grasp it except by means of performing the mitzvos in joy.

steps.title: Rikudin — Sacred Dance
steps.description: Dancing and clapping sweeten harsh judgments and bring joy that transcends all obstacles.
steps.snippet_he: רקודין, הנה איתא ב
steps.snippet_en: Through dance and clapping of hands, harsh judgments are sweetened and transformed into joy.

steps.title: Prayer for Joy (Likutay Tefilos 24)
steps.description: R' Nosson's prayer based on the teaching of joy — pour out your heart asking Hashem for the gift of true simcha.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, זכני לשמחה תמיד
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, grant me joy always. Help me remove all sadness and melancholy with all my strength.

journeys.title: Overcoming Obstacles
journeys.description: When the path seems blocked and the darkness overwhelming, these teachings reveal that every obstacle is actually a gateway. All the distance is really closeness in disguise.

steps.title: All Distance Is Really Closeness
steps.description: The most powerful teaching on perseverance: when you enter Hashem's service, they show you distance — but it is entirely closeness.
steps.snippet_he: כשאדם נכנס בעבודת השם, אזי הדרך - שמראין לו התרחקות. ובאמת כל ההתרחקות הוא רק כלו התקרבות
steps.snippet_en: When a person enters the service of Hashem, the way is that they show him distance. And in truth, all the distance is only entirely closeness.

steps.title: Advice on Strengthening Oneself
steps.description: Collected practical advice on how to hold firm in every situation — ascent or descent.
steps.snippet_he: מי שרוצה לשוב לשם יתברך, צריך להיות בקי בהלכה מאד, שלא יפיל ולא ירחק אותו שום דבר בעולם
steps.snippet_en: One who wishes to return to Hashem must be very expert, so that nothing in the world will cause him to fall or distance him, whether in ascent or descent.

steps.title: Patience — All Suffering Is for Your Good
steps.description: When a person knows that all experiences are for their benefit, this is a taste of the World to Come.
steps.snippet_he: כשאדם יודע שכל מאורעותיו הם לטובתו, זאת הבחינה הוא מעין עולם הבא
steps.snippet_en: When a person knows that all their experiences are for their benefit, this aspect is a semblance of the World to Come.

steps.title: Restoring the Soul — First Steps
steps.description: The opening of Meshivas Nefesh: find good points in yourself to revive and strengthen yourself in His service.
steps.snippet_he: על ידי שמחפשין ומבקשין עד שמוצאין בעצמן איזה נקודות טובות בכדי להחיות את עצמם ולחזק את עצמם בעבודתו יתברך
steps.snippet_en: Through searching and seeking until one finds within oneself some good points — in order to revive oneself and strengthen oneself in His service.

steps.title: Never Give Up
steps.description: A person must cross a very narrow bridge, and the main thing is not to be afraid at all.
steps.snippet_he: והכלל, שהאדם צריך לעבר על גשר צר מאד מאד, והכלל והעקר - שלא יתפחד כלל
steps.snippet_en: And the principle is that a person must cross a very narrow bridge, and the main thing is not to be afraid at all.

steps.title: Prayer for Strength in Service
steps.description: R' Nosson's prayer for the strength to persevere, based on the teaching that all distance is closeness.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, חזקני ואמצני בעבודתך
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, strengthen me and make me courageous in Your service.

journeys.title: Drawing Close to Hashem
journeys.description: A 7-step path of closeness to Hashem, from the very first yearning through deeper and deeper levels of connection. Even the farthest person can draw near.

steps.title: Even the Farthest Can Return
steps.description: Hashem's greatness is that even those very far from Him can draw close — and from them specifically, His Name is glorified.
steps.snippet_he: עקר גדלתו של הקדוש ברוך הוא שגם הרחוקים ממנו יתברך מאד מאד גם המה יתקרבו לעבודתו
steps.snippet_en: The essence of Hashem's greatness is that even those very far from Him can draw close to His service.

steps.title: Settled Mind — The Key to Closeness
steps.description: The world is distant from Hashem because they lack settled mind. Through joy and settled thinking, one draws close.
steps.snippet_he: כשאדם הולך אחר שכלו וחכמתו
steps.snippet_en: When a person follows their intellect with settled mind, they merit closeness to Hashem.

steps.title: Hitbodedut — The Supreme Virtue
steps.description: Personal prayer and meditation is the highest of all virtues and greater than everything.
steps.snippet_he: ההתבודדות הוא מעלה עליונה וגדולה מן הכל
steps.snippet_en: Hitbodedut (personal prayer/meditation) is a supreme and great virtue above all.

steps.title: The Tzaddik Draws All Close
steps.description: Through the true Tzaddik, holy knowledge is spread, and all souls are drawn back to their Source.
steps.snippet_he: אנכי ה' אלהיך אשר הוצאתיך מארץ מצרים מבית עבדים
steps.snippet_en: I am Hashem your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt — through the Tzaddik, holy knowledge reaches every soul.

steps.title: Serve Hashem in Complete Simplicity
steps.description: The main purpose is to serve Hashem in complete innocence and simplicity, without sophistication.
steps.snippet_he: עקר התכלית והשלמות הוא רק לעבד השם בתמימות גמור
steps.snippet_en: The main purpose and completeness is only to serve Hashem in complete innocence.

steps.title: Seal Within a Seal — Faith and Holiness
steps.description: Through faith and prayer, one enters deeper chambers of holiness, rising from level to level.
steps.snippet_he: חותם בתוך חותם
steps.snippet_en: Seal within a seal — through deepening faith and prayer, one ascends through ever higher levels of holiness.

steps.title: Prayer to Draw Close
steps.description: A prayer for closeness — to break through all barriers and draw near to Hashem with a whole heart.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, קרבני אליך
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, draw me close to You. Help me break through all the barriers that separate me from You.

journeys.title: Faith in Hard Times
journeys.description: When suffering seems overwhelming and faith wavers, these teachings are a lifeline. They reveal how the darkest moments contain hidden good, and how faith itself is the vessel that holds all blessing.

steps.title: Faith and Prayer
steps.description: Faith is the root of everything — when one has faith, prayer flows naturally and all gates open.
steps.snippet_he: ואלה המשפטים אשר תשים לפניהם
steps.snippet_en: Through faith, all prayers are accepted, and through prayer, all judgment is sweetened.

steps.title: The Essence Is Faith
steps.description: The main principle is faith — where intellect ends, faith begins, carrying the soul beyond all limitations.
steps.snippet_he: תקעו בחדש שופר בכסה ליום חגנו, כי חק לישראל הוא
steps.snippet_en: The essence of everything is faith. Where the intellect cannot reach, faith carries the soul beyond.

steps.title: Truth and Faith — Collected Advice
steps.description: One hundred and two pieces of advice on building and maintaining faith and truth.
steps.snippet_he: אמת ואמונה
steps.snippet_en: Truth and faith are interconnected — through truth one attains faith, and through faith one sees truth.

steps.title: Faith Overcomes the Evil Inclination
steps.description: Through faith in the Tzaddik and simple wholeness, one overcomes all tests and the evil inclination loses power.
steps.snippet_he: ויסב אלקים את העם
steps.snippet_en: Through faith, even the strongest powers of the Other Side are overcome and sweetened.

steps.title: Healing Through Faith
steps.description: Faith brings healing to all illness of body and soul, connecting a person to the ultimate Source of life.
steps.snippet_he: שאלו תלמידיו את רבי יוסי בן קסמא
steps.snippet_en: Through Torah study and faith, one merits healing and peace — faith is the vessel that contains all blessing.

steps.title: Prayer for Faith
steps.description: R' Nosson's prayer for unshakeable faith — to believe even when everything seems dark.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, חזק אמונתי
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, strengthen my faith. Help me believe with complete faith even in times of darkness.

journeys.title: Healing the Heart
journeys.description: Teachings specifically for restoring a wounded soul. From Meshivas Nefesh (Restoring the Soul) and related works — gentle, compassionate guidance for those who feel broken inside.

steps.title: Finding Good Points to Revive the Soul
steps.description: The beginning of all healing: search for good points within yourself, and through them, all the rectifications of the Temple service are drawn down.
steps.snippet_he: על ידי שמחפשין ומבקשין עד שמוצאין בעצמן איזה נקודות טובות
steps.snippet_en: Through searching and seeking until one finds within oneself some good points, all rectifications are drawn down.

steps.title: Strengthening in Descent
steps.description: Even in the lowest depths, Hashem is there. This teaching provides strength for the most difficult moments.
steps.snippet_he: אם אסק שמים שם אתה ואציעה שאול הנך
steps.snippet_en: If I ascend to the heavens, there You are; and if I make my bed in the depths, behold You are there.

steps.title: The Power of a Single Sigh
steps.description: Even a single sigh of longing for Hashem is precious beyond measure — never underestimate the smallest movement toward good.
steps.snippet_he: אפילו אנחה אחת שאדם מאנח על שאינו כראוי
steps.snippet_en: Even a single sigh that a person sighs because they are not as they should be — this is very precious before Hashem.

steps.title: Never Despair of Hashem's Mercy
steps.description: No matter how far you have fallen, Hashem's mercy is infinite and He waits for your return.
steps.snippet_he: אל תתיאש מרחמי השם יתברך
steps.snippet_en: Never despair of Hashem's mercy. Even if you have fallen very far, His mercy extends to the lowest depths.

steps.title: Azamra — I Will Sing to My God
steps.description: The complete teaching: find the good points, make melodies from them, and through this, sing a new song.
steps.snippet_he: אזמרה לאלהי בעודי
steps.snippet_en: I will sing to my God with what remains in me — find the good and make it into a melody of the soul.

steps.title: Prayer for Healing the Soul
steps.description: A prayer for complete healing of body and soul, drawing from the deepest wells of divine compassion.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, רפאני
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, heal me. Send complete healing to my body and soul from Your infinite compassion.

journeys.title: Prayer & Connection
journeys.description: Learning to pray with depth and feeling. From the mechanics of hitbodedut to the deepest secrets of prayer — a path to making every word count.

steps.title: Hitbodedut — The Greatest of All
steps.description: Personal prayer is the highest virtue. Set aside time every day to speak to Hashem in your own words.
steps.snippet_he: ההתבודדות הוא מעלה עליונה וגדולה מן הכל
steps.snippet_en: Hitbodedut is a supreme and great virtue above all else.

steps.title: Advice on Hitbodedut
steps.description: Practical guidance on personal prayer — how to begin, what to say, and how the words become a form of holy spirit.
steps.snippet_he: הדבורים שאדם משיח ומדבר בינו לבין קונו הם בחינת רוח הקדש
steps.snippet_en: The words a person speaks between himself and his Creator are the aspect of the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Prayer in the Field
steps.description: When a person prays in a field, all the grasses and plants enter into the prayer and help it.
steps.snippet_he: דע, כשאדם מתפלל בשדה
steps.snippet_en: Know, when a person prays in a field, all the grasses and plants join the prayer and give it strength.

steps.title: Prayer, Faith, and the Holy Land
steps.description: Prayer is the gate through which we enter the Holy Land — the spiritual dimension of closeness to Hashem.
steps.snippet_he: תהמת יכסימו, ירדו במצולת
steps.snippet_en: Through prayer and faith, one merits the aspect of the Holy Land — the deepest connection to Hashem.

steps.title: Speaking to Hashem Simply
steps.description: Rabbi Nachman's advice on how to speak to Hashem — like a child to a parent, simply and honestly.
steps.snippet_he: אות - ז
steps.snippet_en: Speak to Hashem simply, like a child speaking to its parent, telling Him everything that is in your heart.

steps.title: The Power of Words in Prayer
steps.description: Each word of prayer has enormous power — when spoken with intention, the words themselves open gates in heaven.
steps.snippet_he: ויאמר בעז אל רות
steps.snippet_en: Through the power of speech in prayer, one draws down divine light and sweetens all harsh judgments.

steps.title: Prayer About Prayer (Likutay Tefilos 25)
steps.description: A prayer asking Hashem for the ability to pray properly — the ultimate meta-prayer.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, זכני להתפלל לפניך באמת
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, grant me the merit to pray before You in truth, with all my heart and soul.

journeys.title: Livelihood & Trust
journeys.description: Teachings on parnassa (livelihood) and bitachon (trust in Hashem). How to navigate financial anxiety, work with faith, and understand that all sustenance comes from Above.

steps.title: The Root of Livelihood
steps.description: Livelihood requires compassion and proper leadership — understanding that sustenance flows through divine channels.
steps.snippet_he: כי מרחמם ינהגם - הינו מי שהוא רחמן, הוא יכול להיות מנהיג
steps.snippet_en: He who has compassion shall lead them — one who is compassionate can be a leader.

steps.title: The Soul's Desire for Money
steps.description: All souls desire money — but this desire must be channeled through melody and love of Hashem.
steps.snippet_he: כל הנפשות תאבים ומתאוים לממון
steps.snippet_en: All souls desire money — the key is to elevate this desire through holy melody and connection to Hashem.

steps.title: Advice on Trust (Bitachon)
steps.description: Practical guidance on developing genuine trust in Hashem for all material needs.
steps.snippet_he: בטחון
steps.snippet_en: Trust in Hashem — cast all your burdens on Him, and He will sustain you.

steps.title: Why Seeking Livelihood Requires Humility
steps.description: When seeking livelihood, one must lower oneself — humility is the key to receiving sustenance.
steps.snippet_he: הקשו: מפני מה כשהאדם מבקש פרנסה
steps.snippet_en: Why is it that when a person seeks livelihood, they must humble themselves? Because sustenance comes through humility.

steps.title: Charity Opens the Channels of Blessing
steps.description: Through giving charity, the channels of livelihood are opened — what seems like loss becomes the source of gain.
steps.snippet_he: דע, שהגוזל את חברו ממון
steps.snippet_en: Through charity and honest dealing, the gates of livelihood open and blessing flows abundantly.

steps.title: Prayer for Livelihood
steps.description: A heartfelt prayer for Hashem to provide sustenance with ease, so one can serve Him without worry.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, פרנסני
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, sustain me. Provide my livelihood with ease and honor, not through hardship.

journeys.title: Peace in the Home
journeys.description: Teachings on shalom bayis — peace between spouses, family harmony, and building a holy home. How to bring the light of the Shechina into your most intimate relationships.

steps.title: Drawing Peace into the World
steps.description: True peace comes from honoring others and fearing Hashem — the foundation of all harmony.
steps.snippet_he: תקעו בחדש שופר בכסא
steps.snippet_en: Through honoring Hashem and honoring others, one draws true peace into the home and the world.

steps.title: Peace Through Torah and Prayer
steps.description: Torah study and prayer are the channels through which peace flows into a household.
steps.snippet_he: יברכנו אלקים וייראו אתו כל אפסי ארץ
steps.snippet_en: When one increases in Torah and prayer, peace radiates outward to bless the entire household.

steps.title: Overcoming Anger
steps.description: Anger destroys peace in the home. These are teachings on how to overcome anger and replace it with patience.
steps.snippet_he: כעס
steps.snippet_en: Anger is the enemy of peace. Through humility and patience, anger is overcome and harmony is restored.

steps.title: Marriage and Holiness
steps.description: Marriage is a holy union that reflects the divine — through repentance and holiness, the bond is strengthened.
steps.snippet_he: ויאמר ה אל משה, קרא את יהושע
steps.snippet_en: Through holiness and repentance, the bond of marriage is elevated and sanctified.

steps.title: Hashem Blesses His People with Peace
steps.description: Hashem gives strength to His people and blesses them with peace — the ultimate blessing that contains all others.
steps.snippet_he: ה עז לעמו יתן ה יברך את עמו בשלום
steps.snippet_en: Hashem gives strength to His people; Hashem blesses His people with peace.

steps.title: Prayer for Peace in the Home
steps.description: A prayer asking Hashem to bring peace, love, and harmony to your home and family.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, תן שלום בביתי
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, grant peace in my home. Let love and harmony dwell among us.

journeys.title: Teshuvah & New Beginnings
journeys.description: It is never too late. These teachings reveal the incredible power of teshuvah — how every moment is a chance to start fresh, and how Hashem eagerly awaits our return.

steps.title: The Ways of Teshuvah
steps.description: Proficiency in running forward and returning — the two skills needed to walk the path of repentance.
steps.snippet_he: ויאמר ה אל משה, קרא את יהושע
steps.snippet_en: One who wishes to walk in the ways of teshuvah must be proficient in both running forward and returning.

steps.title: Wherever the Spirit Goes
steps.description: To wherever the spirit would go, they went — every movement toward teshuvah is guided by the divine spirit.
steps.snippet_he: אל אשר יהיה שמה הרוח ללכת ילכו
steps.snippet_en: To wherever the spirit would go, they went — every sincere movement toward return is guided from Above.

steps.title: A Thought of Repentance
steps.description: Sometimes a thought of repentance comes to a person — the key is to act on it immediately before it fades.
steps.snippet_he: לפעמים בא לאדם הרהור תשובה
steps.snippet_en: Sometimes a thought of repentance comes to a person — seize it immediately, for it is a gift from Above.

steps.title: Strength in Every Situation
steps.description: Whether ascending or descending, strengthen yourself. Even in the lowest depths, Hashem is there.
steps.snippet_he: ובכל מה שיעבר עליו יחזק את עצמו
steps.snippet_en: In all that passes over him, he should strengthen himself — even in the lowest depths, one can draw close to Hashem.

steps.title: Hashem Tests Those He Loves
steps.description: Every test is an expression of Hashem's love — through passing tests, one rises to incredible heights.
steps.snippet_he: ויהי אחר הדברים האלה והאלהים נסה את אברהם
steps.snippet_en: Hashem tested Avraham — every test is born of love, and through it one rises to the highest levels.

steps.title: Prayer for Teshuvah
steps.description: A prayer for the strength to return — to start fresh and leave the past behind.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, עזרני לשוב אליך
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, help me return to You. Grant me a fresh start, a new beginning.

journeys.title: Patience & Humility
journeys.description: The inner work of refining character. Teachings on patience, humility, overcoming anger, and becoming a vessel for divine blessing through lowliness.

steps.title: True Humility
steps.description: The world makes many mistakes about humility — this teaching clarifies what real humility means.
steps.snippet_he: בענין ההכנעה טועים העולם הרבה
steps.snippet_en: In the matter of humility, the world errs greatly — true humility is not what most people think.

steps.title: Pride and Humility — Collected Advice
steps.description: Fifty-three teachings on the balance between pride and humility, and how to cultivate true lowliness.
steps.snippet_he: גאוה וענוה
steps.snippet_en: Pride and humility — through lowliness, one merits everything; through pride, one loses everything.

steps.title: Patience — All Is for the Good
steps.description: True patience comes from knowing that everything that happens is for your eternal benefit.
steps.snippet_he: כשאדם יודע שכל מאורעותיו הם לטובתו, זאת הבחינה הוא מעין עולם הבא
steps.snippet_en: When a person knows that all their experiences are for their benefit, this is a semblance of the World to Come.

steps.title: Overcoming Anger
steps.description: Anger is devastating — these teachings provide the tools to uproot it at its source.
steps.snippet_he: כעס
steps.snippet_en: Anger is one of the worst traits. Through patience and humility, anger is overcome and replaced with compassion.

steps.title: Honor and Peace
steps.description: True honor comes from honoring Hashem and honoring others — through this, one receives genuine respect.
steps.snippet_he: תקעו בחדש שופר בכסא
steps.snippet_en: True honor comes not from seeking it but from giving it — through honoring others, peace flows into the world.

steps.title: Prayer for Humility
steps.description: A prayer to be freed from pride and granted genuine humility and patience.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, הצילני מגאוה
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, save me from pride. Grant me true humility and patience with all people.

journeys.title: The Tzaddik's Light
journeys.description: Understanding the role of the true Tzaddik and how connecting to righteous teachers illuminates the path. The Tzaddik is the channel through which divine light flows into the world.

steps.title: The Tzaddik Reveals Hashem's Light
steps.description: Through the true Tzaddik, holy knowledge and awareness of Hashem spreads to all souls.
steps.snippet_he: אנכי ה' אלהיך אשר הוצאתיך מארץ מצרים
steps.snippet_en: I am Hashem your God who brought you out of Egypt — the Tzaddik reveals divine knowledge to every soul.

steps.title: The True Tzaddik vs. False Leaders
steps.description: How to distinguish between the true Tzaddik and those who glorify themselves in falsehood.
steps.snippet_he: אלו המתפארין עצמן בשקר בגדולות ונפלאות
steps.snippet_en: Those who glorify themselves falsely with great and wondrous things are not true Tzaddikim. The real Tzaddik is known by simplicity and truth.

steps.title: The Tzaddik's Judgment
steps.description: The Tzaddik has the power to judge and rectify — through connecting to the Tzaddik, harsh judgments are sweetened.
steps.snippet_he: ואלה המשפטים אשר תשים לפניהם
steps.snippet_en: The true Tzaddik has the ability to sweeten all judgments and draw every soul back to the good.

steps.title: The Tzaddik's Prayer
steps.description: Through the Tzaddik's prayer, Mashiach is drawn closer and the entire world is elevated.
steps.snippet_he: איתא בספרא דצניעותא
steps.snippet_en: Through the Tzaddik's prayer and charity, the light of Mashiach is drawn into the world.

steps.title: Hidden Tzaddikim
steps.description: There are hidden Tzaddikim in the world whose prayers and service sustain all of existence.
steps.snippet_he: יש צדיקים גנוזים
steps.snippet_en: There are hidden Tzaddikim in the world whose concealed service sustains all of creation.

steps.title: Prayer to Connect to the Tzaddik
steps.description: A prayer to merit connecting to the true Tzaddik and receiving the light of holy guidance.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, זכני להתקרב לצדיקים אמתיים
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, grant me the merit to connect to true Tzaddikim, to receive their holy light.

journeys.title: Hitbodedut Guide
journeys.description: A step-by-step preparation for personal prayer (hitbodedut). From understanding what it is, to finding the right place and time, to the actual practice of pouring out your heart to Hashem.

steps.title: What Is Hitbodedut?
steps.description: The definition: personal, private conversation with Hashem in your own words. The greatest of all spiritual practices.
steps.snippet_he: ההתבודדות הוא מעלה עליונה וגדולה מן הכל, דהינו לקבע לו לכל הפחות שעה או יותר להתבודד בינו לבין קונו
steps.snippet_en: Hitbodedut is a supreme virtue above all — to set aside at least an hour to be alone with your Creator.

steps.title: The Power of Personal Prayer
steps.description: Through hitbodedut, one tastes the hidden light. The words spoken in private become a form of holy spirit.
steps.snippet_he: מי שרוצה לטעם טעם אור הגנוז, ירבה בהתבודדות בינו לבין קונו
steps.snippet_en: One who wishes to taste the hidden light should increase hitbodedut between himself and his Creator.

steps.title: The Best Place for Hitbodedut
steps.description: The field, the forest, the open sky — nature amplifies personal prayer and all creation joins in.
steps.snippet_he: דע, כשאדם מתפלל בשדה
steps.snippet_en: When a person prays in a field, all the grasses and plants enter into the prayer.

steps.title: Set Aside One Hour for a Broken Heart
steps.description: Dedicate a specific time each day for a broken heart before Hashem — then be joyful the rest of the day.
steps.snippet_he: צריכין ליחד איזה שעה ביום שיהיה לו לב נשבר דהינו להתבודד ולשבר לבו לפניו יתברך
steps.snippet_en: One should set aside a specific hour each day for a broken heart — to be alone and break one's heart before Hashem.

steps.title: Hitbodedut and Truth
steps.description: Through personal prayer and solitude, one attains truth and inner peace.
steps.snippet_he: רבי חנינא בן חכינאי אומר הנעור בלילה
steps.snippet_en: One who wakes at night to pray alone merits truth and peace — hitbodedut opens the gates of genuine self-knowledge.

steps.title: Outpouring of the Soul
steps.description: The classic guide to hitbodedut from R' Alter of Teplik — practical instructions on how to pour out your soul before Hashem.
steps.snippet_he: השתפכות הנפש
steps.snippet_en: Outpouring of the Soul — a practical guide to the art of personal prayer and pouring out one's heart.

steps.title: A Prayer to Begin Your Practice
steps.description: End your journey with R' Nosson's prayer about hitbodedut — asking Hashem for the words and the strength to continue.
steps.snippet_he: רבונו של עולם, זכני להתבודד
steps.snippet_en: Master of the Universe, grant me the merit to practice hitbodedut. Open my lips that my mouth may declare Your praise.
